description: AVIVORE is a nation-state threat actor targeting defense and aerospace industries primarily in the UK and Europe. Specializing in espionage, AVIVORE employs a toolset including PlugX, Mimikatz, and WmiExec. Their activities have been observed in campaigns like 'Airbus Attack,' highlighting their capability to breach critical sectors for sensitive information.
